<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:2">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>כולו בלה</he> all goes to ruin.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 9a:2">Bekh. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ובלו להו ואזול</he> they failed and went to destruction.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:22">Ab. V, 22</cite> <he>סיב ובְלֵה בה</he> grow old and frail in it (the study of the Law).—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 62:11">Targ. Ps. LXII, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 91:2">XCI, 2</cite> Ms., v. <he>כְּלִי</he> I.]
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 3:15">Targ. Is. III, 15</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 20a:10">Ab. Zar. 20ᵃ</cite> that this beauty <he>ב׳ עפרא</he> dust will destroy.—Part. pass. f. <he>מְבַלְּיָא</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33">Lev. R. s. 33</cite> (interpret. <he>בלה נאפים</he> <cite ref="Ezekiel 23:43">Ezek. XXIII, 43</cite>) Aquila translates παλαιὰ πόρνη (old harlot), <he>דהוא מבליא גייארא</he> ed. (Ar. <he>דהיא מב׳ גיירייא</he>, Yalk. Dan. 1061 only <he>דהיא מבליא</he>) which means, a wasted harlot (wasted through fornication).
